# ============================================================ # Server action: switch PO lines to the vendor transition UoM # Model: stock.picking (contextual action or Studio button) # Source: product.supplierinfo rows with x_studio_transition = True, # x_studio_vendor_uom set and price expressed in that UoM # Flow A: PO with nothing received and no active bills # cancel receipt -> cancel PO -> back to draft -> # replace transition lines -> confirm (no email) -> # open the new receipt (not validated) # Flow B: PO partially received or billed (cannot be cancelled) # cancel and delete pending moves of transition lines -> # reduce old line to the received qty -> add new line # (Odoo adds its move to the open receipt) -> open receipt # Safety: single savepoint; on any error everything is rolled # back and the error is logged in the chatter # ============================================================ # ---- Constants ---- TRANSITION_FIELD = "x_studio_transition" VENDOR_UOM_FIELD = "x_studio_vendor_uom" SKIP_CONTEXT_KEY = "skip_vendor_uom_rule" OPEN_PICKING_STATES = ["draft", "waiting", "confirmed", "assigned"] CLOSED_STATES = ["done", "cancel"] SAVEPOINT_NAME = "transition_uom" NOTE_SUBTYPE = "mail.mt_note" NOTE_TITLE = "🔄 Cambio a UdM de transición" # ---- Guards (nothing modified yet) ---- if len(records) != 1: raise UserError("Ejecuta esta acción desde una única recepción.") picking = records order = picking.purchase_id today = datetime.date.today() if picking.picking_type_code != "incoming" or not order: raise UserError("Esta acción solo funciona en recepciones de un pedido de compra.") if picking.state not in OPEN_PICKING_STATES: raise UserError("La recepción %s ya está validada o cancelada." % picking.name) # New lines are created with this context so the automatic UoM rule skips them skip_ctx = dict(env.context) skip_ctx[SKIP_CONTEXT_KEY] = True line_model = env["purchase.order.line"].with_context(skip_ctx) # ---- 1. Find PO lines with a transition UoM for this vendor ---- plan = [] warnings = [] for line in order.order_line: product = line.product_id if line.display_type or not product: continue transition = False for s in product.with_company(order.company_id).seller_ids: if not s[TRANSITION_FIELD] or not s[VENDOR_UOM_FIELD]: continue if s.partner_id.commercial_partner_id != order.partner_id.commercial_partner_id: continue if s.company_id and s.company_id != order.company_id: continue if s.product_id and s.product_id != product: continue if s.date_start and s.date_start > today: continue if s.date_end and s.date_end < today: continue transition = s break if not transition: continue t_uom = transition[VENDOR_UOM_FIELD] if line.product_uom == t_uom: warnings.append("ℹ️ %s ya está en %s, sin cambios." % ( product.display_name, t_uom.display_name)) continue if t_uom.category_id != line.product_uom.category_id: warnings.append("⚠ %s: %s no es de la misma categoría que %s, sin cambios." % ( product.display_name, t_uom.display_name, line.product_uom.display_name)) continue t_price = transition.price if transition.currency_id and transition.currency_id != order.currency_id: t_price = transition.currency_id._convert( t_price, order.currency_id, order.company_id, today) plan.append({"line": line, "uom": t_uom, "price": t_price}) # ---- 2. Nothing to do: log and notify ---- if not plan: body = NOTE_TITLE + "
Ningún producto de %s tiene UdM de transición para %s." % ( order.name, order.partner_id.display_name) if warnings: body += "
" + "
".join(warnings) picking.message_post(body=body, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE) action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": { "title": "Sin cambios", "message": "Ningún producto de este pedido está en transición para este proveedor.", "type": "info", "sticky": False, }, } # ---- 3. Apply changes inside a savepoint ---- else: done_moves = order.order_line.move_ids.filtered_domain([("state", "=", "done")]) active_bills = order.invoice_ids.filtered_domain([("state", "!=", "cancel")]) full_flow = not done_moves and not active_bills summary = [] target_picking = env["stock.picking"] error_text = False env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT_NAME) try: if full_flow: # A.1 cancel open receipts, cancel PO, back to draft order.picking_ids.filtered_domain([("state", "not in", CLOSED_STATES)]).action_cancel() order.button_cancel() order.button_draft() # A.2 replace each transition line (qty converted, price as-is) for item in plan: old = item["line"] new_qty = old.product_uom._compute_quantity(old.product_qty, item["uom"]) vals = { "order_id": order.id, "product_id": old.product_id.id, "product_qty": new_qty, "product_uom": item["uom"].id, "price_unit": item["price"], "taxes_id": [(6, 0, old.taxes_id.ids)], "date_planned": old.date_planned, "sequence": old.sequence, "analytic_distribution": old.analytic_distribution, } summary.append("%s: %s %s a %s → %s %s a %s" % ( old.product_id.display_name, old.product_qty, old.product_uom.display_name, old.price_unit, new_qty, item["uom"].display_name, item["price"])) old.unlink() line_model.create(vals) # A.3 confirm (standard confirm sends no email) order.button_confirm() else: # B: PO cannot be cancelled, adjust lines in place for item in plan: old = item["line"] remaining = old.product_qty - old.qty_received if float_compare(remaining, 0.0, precision_rounding=old.product_uom.rounding) <= 0: summary.append("%s: ya recibido completo en %s, sin cambios." % ( old.product_id.display_name, old.product_uom.display_name)) continue new_qty = old.product_uom._compute_quantity(remaining, item["uom"]) vals = { "order_id": order.id, "product_id": old.product_id.id, "product_qty": new_qty, "product_uom": item["uom"].id, "price_unit": item["price"], "taxes_id": [(6, 0, old.taxes_id.ids)], "date_planned": old.date_planned, "sequence": old.sequence, "analytic_distribution": old.analytic_distribution, } # B.1 remove pending moves of the old line from the receipt pending = old.move_ids.filtered_domain([("state", "not in", CLOSED_STATES)]) pending._action_cancel() pending.unlink() # B.2 old line keeps only what was already received old_qty = old.product_qty old.write({"product_qty": old.qty_received}) # B.3 new line: Odoo adds its move to the open receipt line_model.create(vals) summary.append("%s: línea antigua %s → %s %s (recibido) | nueva línea %s %s a %s" % ( old.product_id.display_name, old_qty, old.qty_received, old.product_uom.display_name, new_qty, item["uom"].display_name, item["price"])) target_picking = order.picking_ids.filtered_domain([("state", "not in", CLOSED_STATES)])[:1] env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT_NAME) except Exception as e: env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT_NAME) env.invalidate_all() error_text = str(e) # ---- 4. Chatter + navigation ---- if error_text: picking.message_post( body=NOTE_TITLE + "
❌ No se ha aplicado ningún cambio. Error: %s" % error_text, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, ) action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": { "title": "Error en el cambio de UdM", "message": error_text, "type": "danger", "sticky": True, }, } else: flow_label = "A (pedido cancelado, rehecho y confirmado)" if not full_flow: flow_label = "B (recepción parcial o facturada: pedido ajustado sin cancelar)" body = NOTE_TITLE + "
Recepción origen: %s | Pedido: %s | Flujo %s
" % ( picking.name, order.name, flow_label) body += "
".join(summary) if warnings: body += "
" + "
".join(warnings) if order.state != "purchase": body += "
⚠ El pedido ha quedado en estado %s: revisa si requiere aprobación." % order.state order.message_post(body=body, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE) picking.message_post(body=body, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE) if target_picking and target_picking != picking: target_picking.message_post(body=body, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE) if target_picking: action = { "type": "ir.actions.act_window", "res_model": "stock.picking", "res_id": target_picking.id, "view_mode": "form", "views": [[False, "form"]], "target": "current", } else: action = { "type": "ir.actions.act_window", "res_model": "purchase.order", "res_id": order.id, "view_mode": "form", "views": [[False, "form"]], "target": "current", }
